checks: Electron launches offline with isolated preload and native file storage, no renderer Node access
Native file autosave survives app exit/relaunch, preserving actual fields, images, signature layout and assets
Native JSON export/import uses real files and preserves image-inclusive backup data
DOCX/XLSX open as valid Office packages with values, calculated totals and embedded images; PNG/JPG decode as separate A4 images
Native PDF saving creates a searchable PDF from the same document layout
Closing before the autosave timer fires flushes the latest edit to disk
Multi-page table exports to one Excel sheet per page with cross-sheet totals, and one PNG per A4 page
Cancelling an OS save dialog preserves the document and keeps the editor usable
